title: Runner run profile (how the runner installs, runs and collects one agent)
description: The per-run configuration of services/runner. The boundaries and field names follow the Valkyrie agent contract (vals-ai/Valkyrie docs/agents/agent-contract.mdx, commit 68edd7ac, AGPL-3.0: names and boundaries reused, no code copied): install_cmd, run_cmd, final_output, output_artifacts, install_egress, secrets. Differences, on purpose: commands are argv arrays (no shell); secrets name the platform secret AND where it is injected (never in the agent sandbox); run_egress, timeouts and resources are our extensions (in Valkyrie the BENCHMARK owns the run network policy, with the legacy egress_allowlist on the agent side).

install_cmd.description: Valkyrie `install_cmd` (a shell string there; an argv here). Runs on the TRUSTED side in the task workspace before the agent starts. npm never runs lifecycle scripts: --ignore-scripts is required when argv[0] is npm.

run_cmd.description: Valkyrie `run_cmd` (a shell string with {placeholders} there; an argv here). Runs in the agent sandbox. Placeholders: {workspace} = the workspace path in the sandbox, {model} = the normalized model id, {instruction} = the task instruction as ONE argument (Valkyrie: provided.problem_statement_path).

final_output.description: Valkyrie `final_output` (a path to collect). Here: what the runner collects after the run. `workspace-diff` = the workspace tree is copied out and diffed against the runner's own baseline commit; the result is the patch.

output_artifacts.description: Valkyrie `output_artifacts` (small files collected next to the final output; required unless required: false).

source.description: Where the runner reads it. `stdout` = the run command's standard output.

install_egress.description: Valkyrie `install_egress`: "*" (unrestricted) or the list of hosts reachable while install_cmd runs. [] blocks all.

run_egress.description: Our extension (Valkyrie: the benchmark's run policy). Destinations the agent sandbox can reach while run_cmd runs. `model-gateway` = the per-run model gateway container, which forwards only the model API and adds the key itself.

secrets.description: Valkyrie `secrets` (env var name -> secret store name, resolved at sandbox creation). Here: NAMES only, never values. The platform injects each one into the named container; `sandbox` is not an allowed target.

source.description: Where the platform reads the value (an env var name of the worker, or `run-key` = the run's BYOK key).

timeouts.description: Our extension (Valkyrie leaves timeouts to the benchmark).

resources.description: Our extension. Limits of the agent sandbox container.
